rules.statement: A failure to comply with an order for the pre-payment of costs made under section 63 constitutes a relevant issue.
rules.supporting_quote: (Wijesundera, J. dissenting ) : That on a failure to comply with an order for the pre-payment of costs made under section 63(3) of the Partition Act of 1951, the Court was not empowered to make such an order against the defendant concerned. The consequence of such default would be that the party aggrieved could take immediate steps to enforce that order without waiting till the end of the case to do so
